evidence_policy.current_source: Verified exact-ref selected source, not browser observation.
evidence_policy.proposal: All additions and intent changes await implementation review.
evidence_policy.unknown: No runtime, benchmark or live-provider acceptance is claimed.

recommendations.title: Retain the existing analytical map contract and D3/SVG default
recommendations.user_job: Create worldwide, regional and private local dashboards with exact linked selection and trace.
recommendations.current_source: MapChart chooses PointMap or RegionMap. The plans retain source IDs, typed region groups, metric states and full-source scales; local D3 projections use bundled land.
recommendations.proposal: Keep one Map chart with both analytical modes and the current local renderer. Protect analytical preparation and identity before any new rendering path.
recommendations.benefit: Improves existing jobs without adding a provider dependency or redefining selected records.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Low relative to replacement; targeted regressions and clarity work. Actual SVG workload ceiling is unmeasured.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Keeping only point maps would reduce maintenance but remove useful custom-territory and regional comparison workflows already supported.

confidence.basis: Verified implementation and supplied intent; runtime performance and browser behavior not measured.

proof.acceptance: Existing map tests and deterministic source-ID, typed-key, metric-state and trace oracles agree before expansion.

recommendations.stop_condition: Any expansion that changes analytical results or loses source trace must not ship.

recommendations.title: Close interaction and draft-isolation gaps
recommendations.user_job: Select or clear locations, inspect sources and navigate without changing unrelated charts or committed draft state.
recommendations.current_source: PointMap has no plain SVG background click handler; RegionMap's handles Alt inspection only. PointMap Escape calls live updateChart even with a draft callback. RegionMap guards that call. The preview fixture uses a different ID and omits Escape.
recommendations.proposal: Prove plain empty-space clearing inside the real panel, enforce the draft callback boundary for Escape, and preserve click/Alt/drag/cancel distinctions with one update per completed gesture.
recommendations.benefit: Protects linked filters and host history during ordinary navigation and settings previews.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Low-to-moderate targeted interaction work; avoid unrelated interaction rewrites.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: A clear button alone does not satisfy the established empty-space contract or prevent same-ID draft Escape from reaching saved state.

confidence.basis: Component and provider branches are explicit. Real caller reachability, facet/wrapper behavior and browser reproduction remain to prove.

proof.acceptance: Same-ID draft Escape preserves saved filters; plain dead click clears only own filters; Alt-click, drag threshold, pointer cancellation and toolbar actions do not clear selection.

recommendations.stop_condition: If wrapper behavior differs from the component prediction, refine the smallest fix against the reproduced case.

recommendations.title: Harden existing polygon import with bounded diagnostics and coherent commit
recommendations.user_job: Bring service boundaries into a dashboard and understand why an import is accepted or rejected.
recommendations.current_source: File/paste import exists. isRegionGeometry checks a nonempty Polygon/MultiPolygon FeatureCollection with finite bounded coordinates and closed rings. It has no diagnostic paths, topology guarantee or complexity budget; asset insertion precedes the settings callback.
recommendations.proposal: Keep the supported polygon subset; report feature/ring/coordinate errors, bounds and feature/vertex/property complexity. Define null/CRS/extra-ordinate handling explicitly. Validate before coherent asset/settings commit and decide draft asset retention without silently pruning reusable assets. State holding batches notifications; it is not rollback.
recommendations.benefit: Makes custom boundaries usable while preserving source geometry, selection and reusable assets.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate diagnostics and lifecycle coverage; budgets require measurement. Complete topology repair would be much larger and is excluded.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Documenting the existing generic error is insufficient to locate bad geometry or explain a partially completed asset/settings action.

confidence.basis: Validation and mutation order are source-inspected; specific topology handling and workload limits remain unverified.

proof.acceptance: Deterministic malformed, unsupported, winding, hole, seam and size fixtures produce declared outcomes; rejected commit leaves prior analysis intact; original saved geometry remains unchanged.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not claim general GeoJSON/topology support or silently drop invalid features to pass import.

recommendations.title: Improve the existing join preview while preserving typed keys
recommendations.user_job: Join country or custom-district data confidently and explain unmatched records.
recommendations.current_source: RegionMapSettings already previews all-source unmatched rows/regions and duplicate typed-key groups. planRegionMap distinguishes numeric and string keys and groups repeated geometry keys into one analytical region.
recommendations.proposal: Add mismatched value samples, type distributions, missing-key detail and explicit grouped-feature inspection. Keep all-source and filtered summaries distinguishable; require explicit upstream transforms or reviewed aliases.
recommendations.benefit: Avoids plausible-looking but wrong choropleths and explains why data or geometry is unused.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Low-to-moderate preview work over existing plan results; no fuzzy matching or spatial index required.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Automatic string coercion or best-match field selection would hide type and geography mismatches that affect analytical meaning.

confidence.basis: Current exact-join contract and preview exist; additional presentation detail is a bounded proposal.

proof.acceptance: Keys 1, '1', '01', booleans and missing values reconcile exactly; duplicate polygon parts do not duplicate sums, counts or contributors.

recommendations.stop_condition: Any proposed convenience that changes keys silently is rejected.

recommendations.title: Add a few explicit content controls
recommendations.user_job: Choose the geography, marks, boundaries and labels needed for a worldwide or local dashboard.
recommendations.current_source: One analytical mode renders at a time. Point labelField supplies accessible/readout identity; region labels use the join key. There is no independent reference-boundary overlay or tile context.
recommendations.proposal: Expose Analytical marks, Reference boundaries, Basemap context and Data labels as bounded groups. Default to one analytical family, land context and restrained labels; prove one noninteractive boundary overlay beneath points. Use fixed order and a display label separate from join key.
recommendations.benefit: Supports point sites over service boundaries and legible regional comparisons without a universal layer editor.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate settings, legend, label and interaction coverage; no arbitrary reordering or multiple metric layers initially.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Only an Outline/Streets switch cannot distinguish data labels, reference boundaries and context; omitting all controls leaves the stated render-control job unmet.

confidence.basis: Strong intent and comparator evidence; exact grouping and selected-label demand need a small user-task proof.

proof.acceptance: Each control changes only its named content. Presentation changes preserve filter IDs, counts, denominators, domains and trace; hidden selected marks remain discoverable.

recommendations.stop_condition: Remove a control or overlay slot if it does not materially improve the three exemplar dashboards.

recommendations.title: Select one versioned country pack after an identifier audit
recommendations.user_job: Make a worldwide region comparison without sourcing or preparing boundaries.
recommendations.current_source: mapGeometry loads World Atlas land, not an analytical country catalog. World Bank demo keys include alpha-3-like strings.
recommendations.proposal: Compare the already available World Atlas countries source with a fresh Natural Earth Admin 0 110m-derived pack. Ship one after schema, alias, missing-code, territorial-unit, simplification and notice review; prefer fresh source if the modest preparation cost is justified.
recommendations.benefit: Enables the worldwide dashboard with predictable joins and modest catalog scope.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate reproducible conversion/key review; small ongoing update responsibility. Actual payload and vertex counts unmeasured.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Relabelling the existing land outline as countries supplies no analytical region IDs. Blindly using numeric World Atlas IDs against alpha-3 data creates unmatched rows.

confidence.basis: Sources and historic ID gaps documented; current Natural Earth file schema/crosswalk and browser costs not inspected.

proof.acceptance: One pinned pack joins documented keys including demo codes through audited explicit aliases; exceptions, small islands, terms, vintage and byte/vertex measurements are recorded.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not release a pack without a reproducible identity/key/notice audit or promise universal country-code equivalence.

recommendations.title: Extend shared assets with useful provenance and immutable pack versions
recommendations.user_job: Reuse boundaries across charts and reopen the same analytical geography later or offline.
recommendations.current_source: GeometryAsset contains id, name, source and geometry. The provider saves the shared collection; saved analysis includes geometry. Dashboard DSL text excludes geometryAssets.
recommendations.proposal: Keep that shared-asset boundary. Add optional provenance fields used by real packs; acquire lazily from a host-approved origin and save geometry once. Preserve old assets and use explicit versioned replacements; keep host-supplied assets supported.
recommendations.benefit: Makes saved geography reproducible and its source/terms understandable without a catalog server.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Low-to-moderate optional metadata and compatibility validation; serialization size and host callback cost need measurement.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: A mutable remote URL alone cannot reproduce an old analysis when data changes or the network is unavailable; bundling all candidates adds unused bytes.

confidence.basis: Existing reuse/save behavior is verified; exact metadata shape and bundling choice remain proposals.

proof.acceptance: Two charts share one asset after save/restore offline; keys and provenance remain identical; old saves load; explicit new pack versions never silently replace old geography.

recommendations.stop_condition: Avoid a new catalog service or automatic updater unless a later task establishes the need.

recommendations.title: Preserve metric states, valid denominators and stable color meaning
recommendations.user_job: Compare regions without confusing zero, missing data, invalid measures or changing color scales.
recommendations.current_source: planRegionMap distinguishes empty, invalid and value states, including valid zero. summarizeGroup uses valid numeric inputs for sum/average. Color bounds are based on full source; trace exposes inputs and exclusions.
recommendations.proposal: Keep count/sum/average and existing scale stability. Make joined-row count versus valid-input denominator clear in readouts. Recommend appropriately prepared rates for comparisons, with unit, cohort and period; do not infer normalization or average rates silently.
recommendations.benefit: Prevents misleading choropleths and preserves explanations through filtering, facets and context changes.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Low preservation/readout work; prepared ratios use existing data preparation rather than a new statistics engine.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Coloring unavailable values as zero or scaling each filtered view independently would simplify display but change meaning and comparisons.

confidence.basis: Metric implementation verified; normalization guidance is a contextual recommendation, not a universal ban on totals.

proof.acceptance: Duplicate parts, signed sums, numeric strings, invalid-only, empty and zero fixtures reconcile; mean denominator equals valid inputs, not all joined rows; filter/presentation changes keep the declared domain.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not add automatic area/population denominators or undocumented weighting to improve appearance.

recommendations.title: Compare Leaflet raster and MapLibre vector for one optional street renderer
recommendations.user_job: Recognize streets and places around city sites or local service districts.
recommendations.current_source: The package has no tile renderer. D3 plans mix analytical preparation with projection-dependent positions; React peer support includes 18 and 19.
recommendations.proposal: Use one common deterministic fixture and equivalent context data to compare Leaflet+raster presets with MapLibre+curated vector style. Keep D3 default and ship at most one optional engine. Extract only the small shared semantic seam the proof requires.
recommendations.benefit: Adds useful local context while choosing the smallest engine that satisfies actual control and workload needs.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate-to-high: second rendering lifecycle, camera, host compatibility, picking, accessibility, loading and export. Both candidate integrations are experiments, not a permanent promise.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: The land outline cannot show street relationships. A fixed background image alone does not provide the requested reusable local pan/zoom workflow.

confidence.basis: Capabilities documented; winner, integration costs and actual host/browser behavior unverified.

proof.acceptance: Identical analytical IDs/results and usable selection/trace across candidates; React18/19, camera, resize, failure, accessibility, legibility and supported export contract pass before selecting one.

recommendations.stop_condition: If neither preserves semantics and host requirements at acceptable cost, defer detailed context and retain D3 improvements.
recommendations.dependency_scope: Provider and export gates apply to release selection; start common owned local fixtures before those service checks.

recommendations.title: Make external context a host-configured provider contract
recommendations.user_job: Embed reliable local maps with understandable network, attribution and operational behavior.
recommendations.current_source: No tile/provider configuration exists in current MapSettings. Saved chart settings and host callbacks are established seams, so portable state must be designed before external context.
recommendations.proposal: Host supplies approved endpoint/style/resource origins, public restricted token, attribution and permitted export/offline behavior. Authors choose presets. Keep credentials out of portable analysis state and preserve useful analysis when context fails.
recommendations.benefit: Controls service obligations and failure behavior without asking dashboard users to configure mapping infrastructure.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate but bounded to approved arrangements; provider policy and style changes require an owner.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Hardcoding public OSMF tiles avoids a configuration surface but introduces unchosen service restrictions and a best-effort dependency. Arbitrary user URLs enlarge support scope.

confidence.basis: Configuration boundary is well supported; specific provider entitlement and Mapbox terms remain unresolved.

proof.acceptance: Network audit proves request contents/origins; public-key restrictions, attribution and permissions are reviewed; 401/403/429/5xx/offline/style/GPU failures preserve filters and source access; no secret appears in saves.

recommendations.stop_condition: No live-service adoption, purchase, new credential access or agreement until separately authorized and applicable terms are readable.

recommendations.title: Preserve geographic views and host state across presentation changes
recommendations.user_job: Return to the same area after resize, filtering, restore or switching available context.
recommendations.current_source: MapView stores longitude/latitude center and world-scale multiplier zoom. Drag commits at end. The provider's display-only allowlist does not include view, so view updates can trigger broader work.
recommendations.proposal: Retain the current saved format. If tiled context passes, use a separately tagged detailed camera, translate center/extent on first transition and restore each saved camera thereafter. Keep filter-driven auto-fit disabled and measure/coalesce host updates without assuming current cost is unacceptable.
recommendations.benefit: Avoids jumps, lost views and noisy history while preserving old analyses and facet comparisons.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate compatibility and camera tests; minimal shared geographic intent, no universal camera abstraction.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Copying the existing numeric zoom into a tile engine or fitting every filtered update is simpler but changes the viewed geography unexpectedly.

confidence.basis: View formats and update paths verified; exact mapping and recomputation costs require proof.

proof.acceptance: Old/new save roundtrips preserve intended geography and source semantics; one completed gesture produces one host history entry; resize/facets/dateline/polar cases follow declared limits.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not promise pixel identity across projections or invalidate source coordinates merely because a context projection cannot display them.

recommendations.title: Make selection, trace and navigation usable by keyboard and touch
recommendations.user_job: Use the map's analytical actions without precise dragging, hover or thousands of tab stops.
recommendations.current_source: Map marks have roving focus, labels and keyboard actions. SVG touch-none and pointer panning need real-device review. Component accessibility primitives do not establish complete task accessibility.
recommendations.proposal: Preserve visible focus and exact mark actions; add a bounded source/region action list where dense or canvas views need it. Provide single-pointer pan alternatives, touch-safe page use and readable metric/selection status; retain the repository's shared tooltip/trace pattern.
recommendations.benefit: Keeps analytical workflows available when marks overlap, keyboard focus is used or the renderer is a canvas.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate interaction/manual acceptance work, shared across renderers; no blanket compliance claim.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Renderer keyboard panning or generic ARIA text alone does not expose exact source selection and trace or a single-pointer alternative to dragging.

confidence.basis: Existing controls are inspectable; task-level usability and assistive-technology behavior remain untested.

proof.acceptance: Keyboard, screen reader and touch users can reach a specific coincident source row/region, select, trace, clear and navigate with visible state and no unintended filters; pan works without dragging.

recommendations.stop_condition: A new renderer cannot replace accessible analytical actions with an unlabeled canvas.

recommendations.title: Measure dense workloads and resolve coincident rows before aggregation
recommendations.user_job: Inspect many locations, including multiple records at one site, without losing exact row access.
recommendations.current_source: PointMap draws SVG circles sorted by size/source ID with roving focus; point sizing and opacity already exist. No application benchmark has been run.
recommendations.proposal: Measure 1k/10k/50k point workloads, overlap and one/four panels on a named reference device. First prove a deterministic row list or small hit chooser for overlap. Consider D3 Canvas only if measured rendering cost justifies new picking/accessibility work.
recommendations.benefit: Finds a defensible workload boundary and improves exact inspection without changing analytical granularity.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Measurement low; a chooser/list low-to-moderate; Canvas picking and accessible state moderate.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: A universal point cap copied from another product is unsupported. Coordinate jitter makes points easier to click by changing the displayed locations.

confidence.basis: Need for a measured limit and exact access is strong; thresholds and renderer benefit are unknown.

proof.acceptance: Record actual device/browser/workload, p95 selection/filter/pan, memory, serialization and bytes; exact same-coordinate rows remain individually selectable and traceable.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not add an alternative renderer if current SVG meets the accepted workload and interaction target.

recommendations.title: Prove portable analysis and map image export separately
recommendations.user_job: Save and share a map with its analytical meaning, geography and required context notices intact.
recommendations.current_source: Saved analyses include shared geometry; DSL text excludes it. Ordinary map image-export behavior is unverified from selected source.
recommendations.proposal: Inspect the actual export owner in a runnable checkout. Prove local geometry export first; test detailed capture with resource completion, CORS, styles/fonts, legend, state, resolution and attribution. Require provider permission independently of technical capture.
recommendations.benefit: Prevents blank, incomplete or nonportable output and makes context limitations explicit.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate-to-high for mixed DOM/tile/WebGL capture; provider-specific constraints may justify limited export support.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: A screenshot-like capture alone cannot establish correct resource completion, attribution or permission; silently dropping streets changes the shared view.

confidence.basis: Analysis serialization verified; map-specific image capture and detailed-provider permission are not established.

proof.acceptance: Local and detailed outputs pass their declared tests; denied resources or rights produce a clear result. Offer explicit outline export only if that route passes.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not advertise detailed image export until both technical and permission gates pass.
recommendations.dependency_scope: Local analysis/SVG export can be proved independently; detailed export additionally depends on accepted provider and camera behavior.

recommendations.title: Defer cluster, bin and heatmap modes until contributor semantics earn their cost
recommendations.user_job: Understand density when individual points cannot answer the dashboard question.
recommendations.current_source: Current points are exact source-row marks; no cluster/bin/heatmap analytical mode is present in MapSettings.
recommendations.proposal: Revisit clusters or bins only after measured overlap/workload evidence and a concrete job. Specify aggregation, scale, zoom-dependent grouping, selection and exact contributor access first. Keep kernel heat surfaces later still.
recommendations.benefit: Could reveal concentration while avoiding an unexplained change from source rows to aggregates.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: High relative to styling: aggregate identity, changing groups, legends, trace, selection and accessible alternatives.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Opacity and exact overlap access remain the initial simpler choice; move beyond them only if the declared task still fails.

confidence.basis: Deferral is supported by existing exact-row contract; future demand and thresholds unverified.

proof.acceptance: A prototype aggregate reconciles exact contributors and selected rows across zoom/filter changes and materially outperforms the simpler workflow.

recommendations.stop_condition: No density mode that obscures exclusions, counts or trace targets.

recommendations.title: Defer advanced classification and automatic statistical normalization
recommendations.user_job: Compare meaningful regional quantities across filters, periods and units.
recommendations.current_source: Current regional aggregates are count/sum/average with stable continuous scales and traceable valid inputs.
recommendations.proposal: Keep that contract. Explore fixed manual domains/breaks only for a real comparison job, with explicit saved legend semantics. Defer quantiles/Jenks, smoothing, uncertainty surfaces and automatic denominators; use prepared documented measures first.
recommendations.benefit: Maintains comparability and avoids giving display geometry statistical authority.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Low for clear guidance; fixed classification moderate; general statistical inference high.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Prepared rates with documented numerator, denominator and vintage are the preferred simpler route; only move beyond them for a repeated unmet job.

confidence.basis: Scope limit follows current intent and verified metrics; future classification demand is unverified.

proof.acceptance: If later added, fixed breaks/domains survive filters/facets/restore and expose bins, units and provenance; rate math uses the declared population and period.

recommendations.stop_condition: Never calculate a rate from simplified/projected polygon area or silently average percentages as a population rate.

recommendations.title: Add national and subnational packs only when a dashboard needs them
recommendations.user_job: Compare meaningful local administrative areas using official identifiers and an appropriate vintage.
recommendations.current_source: No maintained analytical geography catalog exists; current service districts are synthetic.
recommendations.proposal: After one country pack succeeds, evaluate one demand-led national-publisher pack: Census states/counties, Statistics Canada provinces/divisions or ONS districts. Keep geoBoundaries a reviewed per-country fallback; avoid a global Admin1 coverage promise.
recommendations.benefit: Offers useful ready-made geography without taking on every country's code and boundary changes.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Moderate per pack: rights/notices, CRS preparation, keys, simplification, vintage and update ownership.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Host-supplied geometry is the simpler first route for infrequent geographies; maintain a bundled/lazy pack only when repeated demand justifies ownership.

confidence.basis: Candidate publishers and IDs documented with explicit schema/size uncertainties; no user-selected national priority.

proof.acceptance: The chosen exact file has reproducible WGS84 preparation, audited string keys, complete notices, stated vintage and measured workload, including unsupported or disputed units.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not equate documentation examples or a public download link with a supported catalog.

recommendations.title: Defer owned offline street packages and PMTiles
recommendations.user_job: Use detailed local context with constrained connectivity or host-controlled data delivery.
recommendations.current_source: Local outlines and saved custom geometry can be available without tiles; there is no offline street pipeline.
recommendations.proposal: Retain the local-outline fallback. Consider host-owned/licensed bounded-area tiles only when an actual offline deployment needs them; PMTiles is one delivery option after renderer/provider decisions.
recommendations.benefit: Could make local detailed context independent of a live third-party service.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: High data preparation, rights, storage, range-serving, cache/version and renderer support cost.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Saved local geometry is the preferred simpler offline behavior until streets are proven essential.

confidence.basis: Deferral is well supported; specific offline dataset entitlement and storage limits unverified.

proof.acceptance: Owned bounded-area data works without network beyond declared host delivery, restores by immutable version and preserves notices and analytical semantics.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not bulk-download public production tiles or promise an offline world package from a renderer choice.

recommendations.title: Keep GIS services and spatial analysis outside this initiative
recommendations.user_job: Build useful dashboards from coordinates, region keys and prepared boundaries without becoming a GIS specialist.
recommendations.current_source: Current maps use supplied coordinates and typed keys. Adjacent network/replay intents do not authorize routing, geocoding or a spatial workbench.
recommendations.proposal: Exclude in-app address geocoding infrastructure, routing/travel times, geometry editing/repair, spatial joins/databases, arbitrary CRS, terrain/3D and automatic network-flow mapping. Reconsider a narrow exception only with a specific job and separately reviewed modest cost.
recommendations.benefit: Keeps the product supportable and preserves focus on dashboard analysis.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Avoids substantial data/service, editing, projection and analytical correctness obligations.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: Coordinates, explicit keys, prepared measures and host-supplied geometry are the simpler accepted workflow; GIS tools can prepare data externally when needed.

confidence.basis: Direct supplied intent; the value of excluded workflows is acknowledged but not a current requirement.

proof.acceptance: The three exemplar dashboards complete their intended jobs using the bounded scope; any claimed exception names the unmet task and a smaller alternative.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not turn comparator feature breadth into implied user approval.

recommendations.title: Avoid permanent competing street stacks and a speculative renderer platform
recommendations.user_job: Get a reliable optional context view without multiplying configuration and compatibility burden.
recommendations.current_source: Point/region plans are application-specific and partly projection-coupled; replay intent is adjacent future scope.
recommendations.proposal: Keep D3 plus at most one accepted optional street engine. A small shared semantic helper may be justified by the proof; a universal scene graph, renderer plugin API and simultaneous Leaflet/MapLibre production support are not.
recommendations.benefit: Limits lifecycle, provider, camera, trace, accessibility and export combinations a personal maintainer must own.
recommendations.maintenance_cost: Avoids long-lived abstraction and duplicate support cost; retain only proof-driven extraction.
recommendations.rejected_simpler_option: A minimal application-specific shared plan is the preferred simpler option; generalization must wait for another concrete consumer.

confidence.basis: Bounded intent and verified current architecture; comparative engine outcome remains open.

proof.acceptance: The chosen implementation supports the accepted jobs with one optional engine and a demonstrably small common analytical contract.

recommendations.stop_condition: Do not ship both experiment engines merely because prototypes exist.

dependency_policy: Dependencies are acceptance prerequisites for the applicable delivered behavior, not a ban on independent local experiments or local-only export proofs.
